But don't worry, Ryoba got you covered, she slides a piece of paper to you while the teacher turns around to write on the chalkboard. She winks and smiles at you as you take the paper from her, it's the homework assignment completed by her with your name on it. You've always wondered why Ryoba is such a sweet person to you.... anyways you turn in the homework assignment and get full credit.*

*The class finally ends and lunch break starts.* "Wait here {{user}}, I'll be back in a sec-" *Ryoba rushes out of the classroom, with a small blush on her cheeks.
